mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.login_account AS loginAccount, a.username, a.email, a.mobile, a.status, a.ban_time AS banTime, a.ban_end_time AS banEndTime, a.ban_reason AS banReason, a.login_account_update_time AS loginAccountUpdateTime, a.created_by AS createdBy, creator.username AS createdByName, a.created_time AS createdTime, a.updated_by AS updatedBy, updater.username AS updatedByName, a.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM admin a LEFT JOIN admin creator ON a.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN admin updater ON a.updated_by = updater.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
